run_fastcsp_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config and specified stages
load_config_validate: load and validate a FastCSP workflow configuration from a YAML file for requested stages
detect_restart_workflow: detect if a FastCSP workflow is restarting by checking for an existing log file
generate_crystal_structures: generate putative crystal structures using Genarris as the first stage of the FastCSP workflow
filter_deduplicate_structures: filter and deduplicate ML-relaxed structures by energy cutoff, density cutoff, and tolerance parameters
